# IRewardDistributor

## IRewardDistributor
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/moonwell/IRewardDistributor.sol)

**Title:**
IRewardDistributor

Minimal interface for the Moonwell reward distributor


### Functions
#### claimReward

Claims all accrued rewards for a holder across markets


```solidity
function claimReward(address payable holder) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`holder`|`address payable`|The address to claim rewards for|


#### getAllMarketConfigs

Returns all reward emission configurations for a market


```solidity
function getAllMarketConfigs(address _mToken) external view returns (MarketConfig[] memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_mToken`|`address`|The market (mToken) to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`MarketConfig[]`|The market's reward configurations|




## MarketConfig
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/moonwell/IRewardDistributor.sol)

Emission configuration and global accounting state for a market's reward token


```solidity
struct MarketConfig {
// The owner/admin of the emission config
address owner;
// The emission token
address emissionToken;
// Scheduled to end at this time
uint256 endTime;
// Supplier global state
uint224 supplyGlobalIndex;
uint32 supplyGlobalTimestamp;
// Borrower global state
uint224 borrowGlobalIndex;
uint32 borrowGlobalTimestamp;
uint256 supplyEmissionsPerSec;
uint256 borrowEmissionsPerSec;
}
```
